veranderings.voor: Jy gaan elke dag skool toe en
veranderings.na: Jy gaan elke dag skool toe, en
veranderings.rede: Two main clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma under AWS 2017; the protected wording after it is untouched.

veranderings.voor: Die Grondwet waarborg daardie basiese onderwys vir elke kind
veranderings.na: Die Grondwet waarborg elke kind se reg op basiese onderwys
veranderings.rede: 'daardie' points back to nothing named, and the next sentence's 'sulke regte' needs a right to refer to; this states the same guarantee more naturally.
'Daarin' clearly means inside the Handves van Regte; 'Daar' is vague.

veranderings.voor: eerbiedig en beskerm, en die onderwys verskaf
veranderings.na: eerbiedig en beskerm, en hy moet die onderwys verskaf
veranderings.rede: The comma before 'en' wrongly splits one sentence sharing a subject; giving the second part its own subject and verb makes the AWS comma correct and avoids a run of 'en'.
Two main clauses, each with subject 'jy' and its own verb, joined by 'en' take a comma under AWS 2017.
One throws rubbish into a bin rather than 'keeps' it there, and 'vullisdrom' is clearer than a bare 'drom'.

veranderings.na: almal wat laer af daaruit skep
veranderings.rede: 'skep' needs to say what is scooped from; 'daaruit' completes it without repeating 'water'.

veranderings.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
veranderings.voor: kom die Nasionale Vergadering uit daardie stemme
veranderings.na: word die Nasionale Vergadering met daardie stemme gekies
veranderings.rede: 'kom ... uit daardie stemme' is wooden; 'word ... gekies' is natural and matches the glossary entry's 'kies'.

veranderings.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
veranderings.voor: Sy lede kies dan die President
veranderings.na: Die lede van die Nasionale Vergadering kies dan die President
veranderings.rede: After three sentences where 'Sy' means the voter, 'Sy lede' briefly reads as 'she'; naming the body removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.blok: Stem is 'n keuse wat saak maak
veranderings.rede: 'vir almal kies' can read as 'chooses everyone'; 'namens almal' clearly means on everyone's behalf.
